text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since No Reasons wasn't feeling well,
I took her on an outing to a certain place.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
So Ieyasu is enshrined here!
choice_data_list: If we're going to visit a shrine, I thought this would be the perfect spot.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Indeed! After defeating the Western Army at the Battle of Sekigahara, he unified the realm and founded the Edo shogunate—a truly great figure!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"'If it will not sing, wait until it sings, little cuckoo' is a poem
that perfectly captures Ieyasu's patience and prudence—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: He's just an amazing warlord, that's what!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Even my worries would be resolved in a jiffy
if Ieyasu were to handle them!
choice_data_list: You're right! Let's go pay our respects right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pat, pat!)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Phew... Now I can rest easy.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, you were praying quite earnestly as well.
What did you wish for?"
choice_data_list: I hope No Reason feels better soon

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! For my sake...!
Alright, let us draw fortune slips right away
to test if our wishes reached the heavens!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle, clatter, clatter...)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—Uwooooh!
Great fortune, babyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
That brought good fortune right away!
Just as expected of Ieyasu!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I want to become someone who gets enshrined in the future too,
and grant the wishes of all sorts of girls!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason flashes a smile at the Great Fortune.
No Reason successfully regained her motivation.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I've decided on this one!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
“—What...?
Great Curse...?”

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"So even Lord Ieyasu himself
finds it difficult to cure my slump, eh...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Disheartened by drawing Terrible Luck,
No Reason was unable to regain his form.
